media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of composer Carl W. Stalling seated at a piano, holding a pencil beside a page of music.
media.publicCaption: Carl W. Stalling at a piano, in a photograph reproduced in the 1991 Bugs Bunny on Broadway album booklet.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; reproduced from Bugs Bunny on Broadway, Warner Bros. Records, 1991; via English Wikipedia.
media.rightsNote: Copyright is not cleared. English Wikipedia identifies the image as a scan from the 1991 Warner Bros. Stalling, a documented contributor in the research graph; it is not used as album artwork, cannot substitute for the commercial recording or booklet, and is accompanied by source, ownership and rights information.
